summary: Log patrol cabin on the Nez Perce NF, built around 1930 and abandoned in 1940; the FFLA list marks it gone and no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: FFLA lists it as Gone; the only dated event in the sources is abandonment in 1940, and no source describes its destruction or any remains

notes_for_editor: Location is ambiguous: firelookout.com and the FS list describe a patrol lookout two miles southwest atop Big Creek Point, while the record coordinates are for Burpee Mountain; the story says so. A Big Creek Patrol listing on idaholookouts.weebly.com (seen only as a search result, not read) places a patrol lookout two miles SW of Burpee Mountain; worth a read if someone wants to settle it. The photo url is the UIdaho item page, not a direct JPEG link; the image itself was not located. About six pages were read, including a 404 on a guessed weebly URL. No source describes the site today. The UIdaho photo caption and firelookout.com both say 16 miles south of Elk City, while the USFS list says 16 miles SE; the story uses the USFS figure and does not reconcile the two.
